subcommands.description: Backup your Charm account keys

subcommands.description: Use charm encryption

subcommands.description: Decrypt stdin with your Charm account encryption key

subcommands.description: Decrypt arg deterministically

subcommands.name: encrypt

subcommands.description: Use the Charm key value store
